name: forge90
description: FORGE 90 is a self-hosted training and meal planner. It builds a 90-day training program, and plans every meal. Workout mode walks you through a session one exercise at a time with a rest timer. It ships with 144 exercises, 141 recipes and 675 foods. Add your own, scan a barcode, search Open Food Facts by name, or import straight from a web link or your Mealie server. The week's shopping list builds itself by aisle, and the pantry keeps you from buying what is already in the cupboard. Recipes and scanned foods are shared by everyone with an account on your server, so the library grows for the whole house. Plans, weigh-ins and training logs stay private to each person. The whole app works on a phone browser or desktop. Default login: admin@forge90.local / forge90-admin (or your ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD).

paths.name: App data
paths.description: Accounts, settings and every user's plan. Back this folder up.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.description: The address people open FORGE 90 at (used in invite and password-reset links). Use your Unraid IP and port, or your https:// domain behind a reverse proxy.

variables.name: SMTP_USER
variables.description: Gmail account that sends invite and password-reset emails.

variables.name: SMTP_PASS
variables.description: 16-letter Gmail App Password for SMTP_USER (spaces are fine). Can also be set later in Admin → Email.

variables.name: MAIL_FROM
variables.description: From address on emails (normally the same as SMTP_USER).

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Default administrator, created on first start only. You choose a new password (and can change the email) at first sign-in.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: First-start password for the default administrator (must be changed at first sign-in).

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Behind a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik): the proxy's IP or Docker subnet, e.g. 172.18.0.0/16 (comma-separated for several), or true to trust any. Leave empty without a proxy. Admin → Server & proxy shows the value to use.

variables.name: REQUIRE_HTTPS
variables.description: Leave empty: plain-HTTP visits are redirected to your https:// APP_URL. Set to false to turn the redirect off (e.g. if the domain is down and you are locked out).

variables.name: COOKIE_SECURE
variables.description: auto marks the sign-in cookie Secure whenever HTTPS is used.
